content.user_title: Convert Notion Specs Into Implementation Plans
content.value_statement: Feature specifications often lack an actionable delivery structure. This skill converts Notion specs into linked plans, tasks, and progress updates.
actual_capabilities: Searches for a Notion specification and asks the user to resolve ambiguous results.
Extracts requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, priorities, assumptions, and clarification needs.
Creates a quick or standard implementation plan linked to the source specification.
Confirms a task database schema before creating scoped tasks with relevant properties.
Links specifications, plans, and tasks, then maintains progress updates and milestone summaries.
limitations: Requires a configured Notion MCP connection and OAuth access to the target workspace.
The package contains only SKILL.md, so referenced templates and examples are unavailable.
Organizes implementation work but does not implement or test application code.
Depends on the specification and workspace schema for accurate task details and assignments.

use_cases.title: Structure a feature delivery plan
use_cases.description: Convert a product requirement into linked phases, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Create engineering tasks
use_cases.description: Break a reviewed specification into scoped tasks with acceptance criteria and database properties.

use_cases.title: Maintain implementation status
use_cases.description: Keep the plan, tasks, blockers, decisions, and milestone summaries aligned during delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Review a specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Notion page titled [SPEC TITLE]. List its requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, priorities, ambiguities, and assumptions. Do not create pages yet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before planning when the specification needs review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a quick plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [SPEC TITLE] into a quick implementation plan. Link the plan to the spec and include phases, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a small, well-defined change.

prompt_templates.title: Build a task breakdown
prompt_templates.prompt: Create implementation tasks from [SPEC TITLE] in [TASK DATABASE]. Confirm required properties first. Scope each task for one or two days.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after requirements and the plan are approved.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a phased delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a standard plan for [SPEC TITLE], generate linked tasks in [TASK DATABASE], and record dependencies, blockers, decisions, progress updates, and milestone summaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a multi-phase feature or migration.

output_examples.input: Create a quick implementation plan for the Notion spec named Audit Log Export.
output: Overview: Deliver CSV export for filtered audit logs.
Requirements: Preserve active filters, stream large exports, and record export events.
Phases: Confirm schema, implement export service, add interface controls, test limits, and release.
Linked tasks: Define export contract; build streaming endpoint; add export action; test permissions and large datasets.

output_examples.input: Break the Customer Merge specification into tasks and identify unresolved decisions.
output: Clarifications: Define the surviving customer rule and confirm merge permissions.
Tasks: Validate candidates; design conflict handling; implement merge transaction; add audit history; test rollback and authorization.
Dependencies: Customer data schema, identity service, and compliance review.
Success criteria: Authorized users merge eligible records without data loss and can review a complete audit trail.

output_examples.input: Prepare a progress update for phase two of the billing migration.
output: Status: Phase two is in progress with three of five tasks complete.
Completed: Historical invoice mapping, reconciliation queries, and staging validation.
Blocker: Finance approval is required for rounding behavior.
Next steps: Resolve rounding rules, complete production rehearsal, and publish the milestone summary.

best_practices: Resolve ambiguous Notion search results and specification gaps before creating plans or tasks.
Confirm database properties and data source identifiers before writing task pages.
Keep relations, status fields, blockers, decisions, and milestone summaries synchronized.
anti_patterns: Do not create tasks from an incomplete specification without recording assumptions and clarifications.
Do not write pages into an unconfirmed database or guess required property values.
Do not assign dates, owners, priorities, or estimates that the specification does not provide.

faq.question: Does this skill require Notion access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a configured Notion MCP connection and OAuth access to the relevant workspace.

faq.question: Can it choose between several matching specifications?
faq.answer: It searches first and asks the user to select a page when results are ambiguous.

faq.question: What plan formats does it support?
faq.answer: It distinguishes quick plans for simple changes from standard plans for multi-phase features and migrations.

faq.question: Can it create tasks in an existing database?
faq.answer: Yes. It confirms the database schema and required properties before creating linked task pages.

faq.question: Does it implement the feature?
faq.answer: No. It produces and maintains planning artifacts but does not write or test application code.

faq.question: Are all referenced templates included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, while the instructions reference separate template and example files.
